human.runner: Cognit HumanDataset pilot; independent operator confirmation required

limitations: No group result implies universal separation of humans and automation.
Browser indicators are experimental signals; missing indicators do not establish human operation.
Within-session attempts are summarized per session before uncertainty is estimated.
A report with unavailable groups or metrics makes no inference about them.

protocol.accuracy: correct / attempts with a boolean correctness result; unknown or absent correctness excluded.
protocol.challenge_set: fixed-challenges.js; compare identical challenge IDs only
protocol.collection: Use source exports as collected; do not infer missing labels, signals, or timings.
protocol.completion_time: Only an explicit completion_time_ms observation is summarized; it is not inferred from attempt timestamps.
protocol.human_false_positive_rate: explicit predicted_automation=true / confirmed human attempts with a boolean prediction and non-empty prediction_provenance.method, origin, and version.
protocol.human_inclusion: HUMAN_CONFIRMED=true plus non-empty method, origin, and procedure from independent review.
protocol.name: Cognit Human vs Automation descriptive benchmark
protocol.uncertainty: 95% percentile cluster bootstrap resampling independent sessions; continuous summaries use per-session means and rates pool observations; 2,000 replicates; deterministic per group and metric. Unavailable below two sessions.
